question: Guru Shashadhar Acharya was awarded the Padma Shri in 2020 for his contribution in which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**lok nritya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Padma Shri** is a **civilian award** in India, given to individuals who have made significant contributions in various fields such as **arts, literature, science, sports, social work, etc.**
 
• **Guru Shashadhar Acharya **is a renowned folk dance exponent from** Odisha, **known for his contribution to the promotion and preservation of traditional folk dances of the state.
 
• He was awarded with** padma shree in 2020**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vadya Yantra Vadan** refers to playing **musical instruments**. 
 
• Any device designed or modified to **produce melodies** is considered a musical instrument. 
 
• **Shastriya Nritya** refers to **classical dance forms.**
 
• **Bharatnatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, sattriya** are among the nine classical dance styles practiced in India.
 
• **Lok Nritya **refers to traditional** folk dances.**
 
• **Ghoomer, Kacchi Gori Chari, and Kalbelia** are a few of the most well-liked folk dances.
 
• **Hindustani Shastriya Gayan** refers to** classical music.**
 
• **Western art music**, which is generally distinguished from Western folk music or popular music traditions, is referred to as classical music.
